notes.title: Summer 2024 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Summer 2024 Update[/h1]

[h2]6 New Wild Cards![/h2]
[olist]
[*] Swap Hands Card - This card allows players to swap their hand with another player's hand.
[*] Steal Card - This card allows players to steal a card at random from another player’s hand.
[*] Table Swap Card - This card forces all players to pass their hand to the next player in the order of play rotation.
[*] Skip Turn Card - This card will skip the next player's turn in the order of play rotation for 1 round.
[*] Reverse Play Order – Once played by the holder, this card will reverse the play rotation. For example, if the play rotation is clockwise the play rotation will change to counter-clockwise. 
[*] Redraw Card - This card allows a player to redraw 1 to 4 of their cards from the deck in one turn.
[/olist]

[h2]New Leaderboards![/h2]
[olist]
[*] Points Scored Leaderboard - This leaderboard is the total collective points scored by a player.
[*] ELO Leaderboard - This leaderboard is the total ELO of a player, ELO is collected based on wins, losses, and final standing at the conclusion of the game. 
[*] Wins Leaderboard - This leaderboard is the total wins a player has achieved.
[/olist]

[h2]Team Gamemode![/h2]
Puzzle Playing Cards includes a 2vs2 mode wherein players team up and collectively race to win by incorporating teamwork. Players 1 plus 3 and 2 plus 4 are paired together as teams. Their points are counted separately and then added to a collective team points pool that is used to determine who wins the game. 

[h2]New Assets[/h2]
All UI assets have been redone!
